plan.notes: Official 2026-2027 Major Map (recommended sequence) for the B.A. in Public Health, Arnold School of Public Health, Public Health Programs, from the USC Major Map Repository detail page. All 8 semesters transcribed; semester sums verified against printed totals (15/15/15/15/15/15/15/12 at slot minimums = 117 total; official degree minimum 120 per Graduation Requirements Summary: 120 total, 24 major, 53-65 college/program, 31-43 Carolina Core, 2.000 GPA — range slots/electives fill to 120+). Ranged Carolina Core slots transcribed at minimums with notes. The Semester Eight 'Elective (only if needed to meet hours to graduate)' 0-2 cr slot is marked required_zero per the BACKLOG-18 variable-credit convention. Two cognates of 12 credit hours each (300-level or above, advisor-approved) required; foreign language proficiency equivalent to the 110 course required. Retrieved 2026-10-09.
